Description(Details, listed): African Violet is a beloved flowering houseplant featuring velvety soft leaves forming compact rosettes crowned with abundant colorful blooms in purple, pink, white, or bi-color combinations year-round. This classic indoor plant originates from East African highlands, thriving indoors with proper care producing continuous blooming cycles. African Violets purify indoor air while bringing cheerful floral beauty to windowsills, shelves, or desktops with their charming petite flowers and fuzzy foliage.
